captain-lawgof.speaker: Captain Lawgof
captain-lawgof.text: Guthix be praised, the cavalry has arrived! Hero, how would you like to be made an honorary member of the Black Guard?

captain-lawgof.speaker: Captain Lawgof
captain-lawgof.text: Hawhaw! 'What's that' [he/she] asks, what a sense of humour! The Black Guard is the finest regiment in the dwarven army. Only the best of the best are allowed to join it and then they receive months of rigorous training.

captain-lawgof.speaker: Captain Lawgof
captain-lawgof.text: However, we are currently in need of a hero, so for a limited time only I'm offering you, a human, a chance to join this prestigious regiment. What do you say?

steps.player: Sure, I'd be honoured to join.

steps.speaker: Captain Lawgof
steps.text: That's the spirit! Now trooper, we have no time to waste - the goblins are attacking from the forests to the South. There are so many of them, they are overwhelming my men and breaking through our

steps.speaker: Captain Lawgof
steps.text: perimeter defences; could you please try to fix the stockade by replacing the broken rails with these new ones?
The Dwarf Captain gives you six railings.
If the player does not have a hammer:

steps.speaker: Captain Lawgof
steps.text: You'll need this hammer too.
a hammer

steps.speaker: Captain Lawgof
steps.text: Report back to me once you've fixed the railings.

steps.player: I'm sorry, I'm too busy mining.

steps.speaker: Captain Lawgof
steps.text: Well best make the most of it while you can, if the goblins over-run us they'll descend on the mines like a plague of locusts!

captain-lawgof-inspecting-the-broken-mul.text: The Black Guard sent Lawgof this cannon to help defend the mines against the goblins.

fixing-the-railings-trying-to-fix-a-rail.text: This railing is broken and needs to be replaced.
If the player does not have a railing:

steps.player: I'm not going to be able to fix this without a new railing. Lawgof should have some spare ones.

fixing-the-railings-trying-to-fix-a-rail.text: You attempt to repalce the broken railing...
If the player does not have a hammer:

steps.text: You will need a hammer to fix the railings.

fixing-the-railings-trying-to-fix-a-rail.text: If the player fails to repair the railing:

steps.text: Your arm is getting tired.
You cut yourself on the rusty old railing.
You accidentally crush your hand in the railing.
You wrench your back trying to handle the railings.
(The player is dealt 0-2 damage.)

fixing-the-railings-trying-to-fix-a-rail.text: If the player successfully repairs the railing:

steps.text: This railing is now fixed.

fixing-the-railings-trying-to-fix-a-rail.text: If all the railing are fixed:

steps.player: I've fixed all these railings now.

fixing-the-railings-inspecting-a-fixed-r.player: I've fixed all these railings now.

fixing-the-railings-using-other-items-on.player: That's better, the goblins won't get past this piece of fencing now.

fixing-the-railings-talking-to-captain-l.speaker: Captain Lawgof
fixing-the-railings-talking-to-captain-l.text: Hello, trooper, how are you doing with those railings?

fixing-the-railings-talking-to-captain-l.speaker: Captain Lawgof
fixing-the-railings-talking-to-captain-l.text: The goblins are still getting in, so there must still be some broken railings.
If the player has no railings:

steps.speaker: Captain Lawgof
steps.text: That's okay, we've got plenty, here you go.
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.speaker: Captain Lawgof
steps.text: There's no room in your backpack, so I can't give you anymore.
The Dwarf Captain gives you another railing.

fixing-the-railings-talking-to-captain-l.text: If the player has at least 1 railing:

steps.player: Don't worry, I'll find them soon enough.

fixing-the-railings-talking-to-captain-l.speaker: Captain Lawgof
fixing-the-railings-talking-to-captain-l.text: Well done, trooper! The goblins seems to have stopped getting in. I think you've done the job!

fixing-the-railings-talking-to-captain-l.player: Great, I'll be getting on then.

fixing-the-railings-talking-to-captain-l.speaker: Captain Lawgof
fixing-the-railings-talking-to-captain-l.text: What? I'll have you jailed for desertion!

fixing-the-railings-talking-to-captain-l.speaker: Captain Lawgof
fixing-the-railings-talking-to-captain-l.text: Besides, I have another commission for you. Just before the goblins over-ran us we lost contact with our watch tower to the South, that's why the goblins managed to catch us unawares. I'd like you to perform

fixing-the-railings-talking-to-captain-l.speaker: Captain Lawgof
fixing-the-railings-talking-to-captain-l.text: a covert operation into enemy territory, to check up on the guards we have stationed there.

fixing-the-railings-talking-to-captain-l.speaker: Captain Lawgof
fixing-the-railings-talking-to-captain-l.text: They should have reported in by now ...

fixing-the-railings-talking-to-captain-l.player: Okay, I'll see what I can find out.

fixing-the-railings-talking-to-captain-l.speaker: Captain Lawgof
fixing-the-railings-talking-to-captain-l.text: Excellent! I have two men there, the dwarf-in-charge is called Gilob, find him and tell him that I'll send him a relief guard just as soon as we mop up these remaining goblins.

fixing-the-railings-talking-to-captain-l.speaker: Captain Lawgof
fixing-the-railings-talking-to-captain-l.text: Hello, any news from the watchman?

fixing-the-railings-talking-to-captain-l.speaker: Captain Lawgof
fixing-the-railings-talking-to-captain-l.text: Well, as quick as you can then.

finding-the-remains-picking-up-the-remai.text: If the player already has the remains:

steps.player: What? Carrying one set of Dwarf remains is enough...

finding-the-remains-picking-up-the-remai.player: I had better take these remains. {{^|Remains drop to ground with full inventory.}}

finding-the-remains-talking-to-captain-l.speaker: Captain Lawgof
finding-the-remains-talking-to-captain-l.text: Have you been to the watch tower yet?

finding-the-remains-talking-to-captain-l.player: Yes, I went up but there was no one there.

finding-the-remains-talking-to-captain-l.speaker: Captain Lawgof
finding-the-remains-talking-to-captain-l.text: That's strange, Gilob would never leave his post... His son was also with him, something doesn't smell right. Can you return and look for clues?

finding-the-remains-talking-to-captain-l.player: Of course, I'll do what I can.

finding-the-remains-talking-to-captain-l.speaker: Captain Lawgof
finding-the-remains-talking-to-captain-l.text: Have you been to the watch tower yet?

finding-the-remains-talking-to-captain-l.player: I have some terrible news for you Captain, the goblins over ran the tower, your guards fought well but were overwhelmed.

finding-the-remains-talking-to-captain-l.text: You give the Dwarf Captain his subordinate's remains...

finding-the-remains-talking-to-captain-l.speaker: Captain Lawgof
finding-the-remains-talking-to-captain-l.text: I can't believe it, Gilob was the finest lieutenant I had! We'll give him a fitting funeral, but what of his command? His son, Lollk, was with him. Did you find his body too?

finding-the-remains-talking-to-captain-l.player: No, there was only one body there, I searched pretty well.

finding-the-remains-talking-to-captain-l.speaker: Captain Lawgof
finding-the-remains-talking-to-captain-l.text: The goblins must have taken him. Please traveler, seek out the goblins' hideout and return the lad to us. They always attack from the South-east, so they must be based down there.

finding-the-remains-talking-to-captain-l.player: Okay, I'll see if I can find their hideout.

the-dwarf-child-searching-the-crate-cont.text: You search the crate but find nothing.
Inside you see a dwarf child, tied up!

the-dwarf-child-searching-the-crate-cont.speaker: Lollk
the-dwarf-child-searching-the-crate-cont.text: Thank the heavens, you saved me! I thought I'd be goblin lunch for sure!

the-dwarf-child-searching-the-crate-cont.speaker: Lollk
the-dwarf-child-searching-the-crate-cont.text: I think so, I'd better run off home.

the-dwarf-child-searching-the-crate-cont.player: That's right, you get going, I'll catch up.

the-dwarf-child-searching-the-crate-cont.text: The dwarf child runs off into the caverns.

the-dwarf-child-talking-to-captain-lawgo.speaker: Captain Lawgof
the-dwarf-child-talking-to-captain-lawgo.text: He has, and I thank you from the bottom of my heart - without you he'd be a goblin barbecue!

the-dwarf-child-talking-to-captain-lawgo.speaker: Captain Lawgof
the-dwarf-child-talking-to-captain-lawgo.text: In that case could I ask one more favour of you...

the-dwarf-child-talking-to-captain-lawgo.speaker: Captain Lawgof
the-dwarf-child-talking-to-captain-lawgo.text: When the goblins attacked us some of them managed to slip past my guards and sabotage our cannon. I don't have anybody who understands how it works, could you have a look at it and see if you could get it working for

options.text: Okay, I'll see what I can do.

steps.player: Okay, I'll see what I can do.

steps.speaker: Captain Lawgof
steps.text: Thank you, take this toolkit, you'll need it...
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.speaker: Captain Lawgof
steps.text: You don't have room to take this, report back to me when you do.
The Dwarf Captain gives you a tool kit.

steps.speaker: Captain Lawgof
steps.text: Report back to me if you manage to fix it.

options.text: Sorry, I've done enough for today.

steps.player: Sorry, I've done enough for today.

steps.speaker: Captain Lawgof
steps.text: Fair enough, didn't think you'd be able to help anyway, not much chance for a human to be able to fix it when the best dwarven engineers have failed.

fixing-the-cannon-inspecting-the-broken-.player: I guess I'd better fix it with the toolkit I was given.

fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-captain-law.speaker: Captain Lawgof
fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-captain-law.text: How are you doing in there, trooper? We've been trying our best with that thing, but I just haven't got the patience.

fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-captain-law.player: It's not an easy job, but I'm getting there.

fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-captain-law.speaker: Captain Lawgof
fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-captain-law.text: Good stuff, let me know if you have any luck. If we manage to get that thing working, those goblins will be no trouble at all.
If the player lost the toolkit:

steps.player: I'm afraid I lost the toolkit...

steps.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.speaker: Captain Lawgof
steps.text: That was silly... never mind, I can give you another, but you'll have to free up some space in your backpack first.

steps.speaker: Captain Lawgof
steps.text: That was silly... never mind, here you go.
The Dwarf Captain gives you another toolkit.

fixing-the-cannon-fixing-the-cannon.text: Well done! You've fixed the cannon! Better go and tell Captain Lawgof.

fixing-the-cannon-fire-the-fixed-dwarf-m.player: This should work nicely now that I've fixed it.

fixing-the-cannon-pick-up-the-fixed-dwar.speaker: Captain Lawgof
fixing-the-cannon-pick-up-the-fixed-dwar.text: What do you think you're doing, trooper! Did I give you orders to move that cannon? No! Well then don't!

fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-captain-law.player: Well, I think I've done it, take a look...

fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-captain-law.speaker: Captain Lawgof
fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-captain-law.text: Well I don't believe it, it seems to be working perfectly! I seem to have underestimated you, trooper!

fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-captain-law.player: Not bad for an adventurer eh?

fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-captain-law.text: You give the toolkit back to Captain Lawgof.

fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-captain-law.speaker: Captain Lawgof
fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-captain-law.text: Not bad at all, your effort is appreciated, my friend. Now, if I could figure what the thing uses as ammo...

fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-captain-law.speaker: Captain Lawgof
fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-captain-law.text: The Black Guard forgot to send instructions. I know I said that was the last favour, but...

fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-captain-law.speaker: Captain Lawgof
fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-captain-law.text: I can't leave this post, could you go to the Black Guard base and find out what this thing actually shoots?

steps.speaker: Captain Lawgof
steps.text: Fair enough, fair enough.

steps.speaker: Captain Lawgof
steps.text: That's great, we were lucky you came along when you did. The base is located just South of the Ice Mountain.

steps.speaker: Captain Lawgof
steps.text: You'll need to speak to Nulodion, the Dwarf Cannon engineer. He's the Weapons Development Chief for the Black Guard, so if anyone knows how to fire this thing, it'll be him.

steps.player: Okay, I'll see what I can do.

fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-captain-law.speaker: Captain Lawgof
fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-captain-law.text: Hello trooper, any word from the Cannon Engineer?

fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-captain-law.speaker: Captain Lawgof
fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-captain-law.text: The Black Guard camp is South of the Ice Mountain, the quicker we can get some ammo for this thing the quicker those Goblins will leave us be.

fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-nulodion.player: Captain Lawgof sent me. He's having trouble with his cannon.

fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-nulodion.speaker: Nulodion
fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-nulodion.text: Of course, we forgot to send the ammo mould!

fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-nulodion.speaker: Nulodion
fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-nulodion.text: Don't be silly - the ammo's made by using a mould. Here, take these to him. The instructions explain everything.
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.speaker: Nulodion
steps.text: You can't take these things unless you free up some space in your inventory. I suggest you visit a bank and then come back to talk to me.

fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-nulodion.text: The Cannon Engineer gives you some notes and a mould.

fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-nulodion.speaker: Nulodion
fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-nulodion.text: Thank you, adventurer. The Dwarf Black Guard will remember this.

fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-nulodion-ag.text: If the player lost the notes:

steps.speaker: Nulodion
steps.text: Here, take these...

fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-nulodion-ag.text: If the player lost the ammo mould:

steps.speaker: Nulodion
steps.text: Deary me, you are trouble. Here, take this one.

fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-nulodion-ag.speaker: Nulodion
fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-nulodion-ag.text: So has the Captain figured out how to work the cannon yet?

fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-nulodion-ag.player: Not yet, but I'm sure he will.

fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-nulodion-ag.speaker: Nulodion
fixing-the-cannon-talking-to-nulodion-ag.text: If you can get those items to him it'll be a great help.

talking-to-lawgof-after-getting-the-ammo.speaker: Captain Lawgof
talking-to-lawgof-after-getting-the-ammo.text: Hello trooper, any word from the Cannon Engineer?

talking-to-lawgof-after-getting-the-ammo.player: Yes, I have spoken to him.

talking-to-lawgof-after-getting-the-ammo.text: If the player does not have the notes and ammo mould:

steps.player: He gave me some items to give you... but I seem to have lost something.

steps.speaker: Captain Lawgof
steps.text: If you could go back and get another, I'd appreciate it.

talking-to-lawgof-after-getting-the-ammo.player: He gave me an ammo mould and some notes to give to you...

talking-to-lawgof-after-getting-the-ammo.speaker: Captain Lawgof
talking-to-lawgof-after-getting-the-ammo.text: Aah, of course, we make the ammo! This is great, now we will be able to defend ourselves. I don't know how to thank you...

talking-to-lawgof-after-getting-the-ammo.player: You could give me a cannon...

talking-to-lawgof-after-getting-the-ammo.speaker: Captain Lawgof
talking-to-lawgof-after-getting-the-ammo.text: Hah! You'd be lucky, those things are worth a fortune.

talking-to-lawgof-after-getting-the-ammo.speaker: Captain Lawgof
talking-to-lawgof-after-getting-the-ammo.text: I'll tell you what though, I'll write to the Cannon Engineer requesting him to sell you one. He controls production of the cannons.

talking-to-lawgof-after-getting-the-ammo.speaker: Captain Lawgof
talking-to-lawgof-after-getting-the-ammo.text: He won't be able to give you one, but for the right price, I'm sure he'll sell one to you.

talking-to-lawgof-after-getting-the-ammo.player: Hmmm... sounds interesting, I might take you up on that.
